## Institutional recognition {#institutional-recognition}

### CSU Fullerton: normalized citation impact

[Institutional ranking · CSUF News · January 28, 2022]{.record-type}

CSUF News reported that California State University, Fullerton ranked **third
among U.S. public universities** for normalized citation impact in the U.S. News
& World Report rankings. The article also reports second place among all
California universities and discusses research publications from **2015–2019**.
This is a citation-impact measure, not an overall university ranking.

My connection is my [master's degree in Computer Science at CSUF](../about/index.qmd#education).
The report provides context for that academic affiliation; it does **not** name
me as an award recipient or establish the citation impact of my own publications.

**Source:** Valerie Orleans, [“Cal State Fullerton Ranks Third Among U.S. Public
Universities for Faculty Research Impact,” CSUF News](https://news.fullerton.edu/2022/01/cal-state-fullerton-ranks-third-among-u-s-public-universities-for-citation-impact/),
January 28, 2022.
